def: sight, whether abstractly (vision) or concretely (a spectacle)

occurrences.text: And she called the name of the Lord that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the Lord said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.
His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
